_about: Cross-venue canonical asset map. A group key is <kind>:<SYMBOL> with kind in
crypto | equity | commodity | index | private. Venue rules (lsl/assets.py):
hl_spot (whitelisted tokens only)             -> crypto:<underlying from hl_spot_whitelist.json>
hl_perp (main dex)                            -> crypto:<coin>, after multiplier rules
hl_dex:<dex> (HIP-3 'dex:SYM')                -> strip prefix, kind from dex_kinds; for 'tradfi' dexes the
kind is tradfi_kinds[SYM] if listed, else equity
Multiplier rules (HL perps only): ^k([A-Z0-9]+)$ and ^1000([A-Z0-9]+)$ -> base symbol, multiplier 1000.
`aliases` then renames whole keys (ticker changes etc.).
Ambiguous -> not grouped (own 'unmapped:' group) and listed in data_quality.json: a HIP-3 dex missing from
dex_kinds, an adjusted option chain symbol (^[A-Z]+[0-9]+$), an unresolved symbol ('?', 'pair:...').
To extend: add the dex to dex_kinds or a key to aliases, then run `bin/lsl selftest` and recompute.
